title: Prediction
description: The upstream predictor that HIKAE conforms (the fourth interface contract). Pipeline: predictor -> Prediction -> HIKAE conformer -> CoverageVerdict -> GateDecision. Contract 1.1.0: schema_version keeps a version pattern, not a constant, so that a caller on another version gets the named refusal schema_version_unsupported and not a generic validation error; the server accepts 1.1.0 only. ADR-M001 Decision 6.
